recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-47289 unless a later tracker changes Subscription $events semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-47289 is an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-I change request asking to replace unclear Subscription $events parameter descriptions for eventsSinceNumber and eventsUntilNumber with explicit lower-bound and upper-bound inclusive wording.
initial_application: The source change was already applied upstream in commit 1d0630ea0ab5d245d14c8150ff90a51889adf888, referenced from the Jira-linked merged PR 3967, which changed the two parameter documentation strings in source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-events.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists subscription=Subscription, and source/subscription/list-Subscription-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Subscription-events, confirming the OperationDefinition is in the active Subscription build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2025-03-31 list FHIR-47289 in the Subscriptions block vote approved 17-0-0. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already contains the approved descriptions for both eventsSinceNumber and eventsUntilNumber.
